findings.description: Plugin install NAME differs from its source DIRECTORY for ralph-orchestration (name 'ralph-orchestration' -> dir 'plugins/ralph'), verified in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. A naive <toolkit>/plugins/<name> source lookup fails for AC2 (codex install of ralph-orchestration) and AC7 (discovery sourceVersion). source.js must resolve the source dir via the marketplace index plugins[].source.
findings.resolution: source.js now resolves plugin name -> source dir via the marketplace index plugins[].source; sourceVersion read from <resolved-source-dir>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json. Updated Architecture, In-Scope, listPlugins, AC2, AC7, and added a plugin-provisioning-source.test.js assertion for the ralph-orchestration case. Added a Risk Area.

findings.description: install-plugin is mutating global/user plugin state but auth was left as an open question. cli auth:open does not by itself enforce --as; existing operator-trust commands (spawn-member/stop-member) add a handler-side --as <lead> / resolveActorRole === 'lead' check. Plan must make lead enforcement mandatory and test non-lead / missing-as rejection.
findings.resolution: Auth promoted from Open Question to a decided In-Scope bullet with handler-side lead enforcement; added AC12 (slash rejects non-lead, CLI requires --as/in-session auto-resolve) and US-006 test note.

findings.description: Plan said operator-trust install-plugin makes its generated skill 'slash-only prose', and 'the thin skill wraps the CLI' was imprecise. gen-skills generation is slash-intercept-primary; the Skill-tool CLI fallback is Claude-side. Clarify the slash-intercept + CLI-fallback model.
findings.resolution: Corrected the Open Questions auth note: verified against real skills/stop-member/SKILL.md that operator-trust commands DO get a CLI-wrapping body with an --as/in-session-auto-resolve callout (skillFallbackProse gates only on !cliEnabled || SLASH_ONLY). Clarified primary path = slash interception via UserPromptSubmit; skill body = post-run confirmation + (Claude) Skill-tool CLI fallback.

findings.description: claude plugin list --json can return the same plugin across BOTH user and project scopes (this box already shows a duplicate for crews@ai-developer-toolkit). Installing --scope user may not fix a stale project-scoped plugin. The claude adapter must specify scope handling + duplicate-list handling, and the verdict must carry the resolved scope.
findings.resolution: claude adapter description + In-Scope + AC6 updated: default --scope user, key on the user-scope entry, surface a conflicting project-scoped entry, carry resolved scope in the verdict, unit-test the duplicate-list case. Added a Risk Area.

findings.description: The 'claude CLI absent' settings.json fallback cannot actually install/upgrade: editing ~/.claude/settings.json enables a plugin but cannot populate ~/.claude/plugins/cache. The fallback must be narrowed to 'enable an already-cached version' or explicitly fail.
findings.resolution: Narrowed the claude settings.json fallback to ENABLE-an-already-cached-version only; when the version is not cached and the CLI is absent, the adapter returns status:failed with an actionable 'claude CLI required to install/populate cache' message. AC6 covers enable-from-cache and the no-cache failure.

findings.description: A local-source marketplace exposes exactly one version (the checkout's). --exact <v> where v differs from sourceVersion and is not already installed cannot be satisfied; the plan lacked criteria for this impossible case.
findings.resolution: Added an In-Scope bullet and AC11: --exact mismatch (not already installed) returns status:failed with an actionable message naming sourceVersion; no mutating call made.

findings.description: AC9 said dry-run status 'reflects the would-be action' without defining allowed values.
findings.resolution: AC9 pins the dry-run verdict: reuse the status enum (no-op/installed/upgraded) for the would-be action + dryRun:true, restartRequired/currentThreadUsable computed as if applied, summary phrased 'would install/upgrade'; zero mutating calls.

findings.description: Unit tests with injected runners cannot catch native-CLI output/shape drift; a non-mutating live smoke for list-plugins / install --dry-run was missing.
findings.resolution: Added AC13: a CREWS_PROVISIONING_LIVE=1-gated smoke that runs list-plugins + install --dry-run against the real engine CLI and asserts the JSON verdict shape (skipped by default). Folded into US-007.

findings.description: command-registry-shape.test.js has hard-coded listCommands('member')/('lead') arrays; the registry change and these test arrays must land in the same story.
findings.resolution: US-006/US-007 notes now explicitly require updating the hard-coded listCommands arrays in the same story as the registry change.

findings.description: buildVerdict defined currentThreadUsable = !restartRequired, so a failed install (restartRequired false) would report currentThreadUsable true — contradicting the load-bearing restart verdict (a blocked member still cannot use the plugin after a failed install).
findings.resolution: Replaced the naive formula with a per-status table: no-op (false/true), installed|upgraded (true/false), failed (false / pre-action-installed-and-enabled-only). AC8 now asserts a failed install never claims currentThreadUsable when the plugin was not already usable.

findings.description: Claude reviewer claimed an operator-trust install-plugin would generate a slash-only skill with no CLI-wrapping body, so the 'thin skill that wraps the CLI' would not materialize.
findings.resolution: FALSE POSITIVE. Verified against the real skills/stop-member/SKILL.md (an operator-trust command): gen-skills emits a CLI-wrapping body 'Run the CLI mirror via Bash ... node $CREWS_BIN stop-member' plus an --as/in-session-auto-resolve callout. skillFallbackProse gates only on (!cliEnabled || SLASH_ONLY_SKILL_COMMANDS), NOT on requiresLeadAs. The codex lens independently confirmed this (its Low finding). The plan's framing holds; the Open Questions note was corrected for clarity (see F-003).
